canonical_statement: For a finite Galois extension L/K of number fields and a finite-dimensional complex representation rho of Gal(L/K), define the Artin L-function by the Euler product of determinant factors on inertia invariants; the classical theorem package sought here is its meromorphic continuation and functional equation.
claim_qualification: The exact normalization and source theorem remain to be pinned. General holomorphy for nontrivial irreducible rho is not part of this target.
domains_and_universes: Number fields K and L; a finite Galois extension L/K; a finite-dimensional complex vector space V; rho : Gal(L/K) -> GL(V); complex variable s.
ordered_binders: L : finite Galois extension of K
hypotheses: rho is a finite-dimensional complex representation
conclusion: A concretely defined Artin Euler product has the source-normalized meromorphic continuation and functional equation.
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: The zero-dimensional representation gives the constant Euler product and must be handled by the chosen convention.
The trivial representation should agree with the appropriate Dedekind zeta function.
Ramified primes require inertia-invariant local factors.
General Artin holomorphy is excluded rather than silently assumed.
